name: Epitalon
description: Synthetic 4-amino-acid peptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly), based on a cattle pineal gland extract

note.text: Most studies come from one group in St. Petersburg, Russia. FDA found three studies in people and none that assessed safety.

bullets: **Switched on telomerase** and lengthened telomeres in human fetal lung cells (lab)
**Raised evening melatonin** in old monkeys; not in young ones
**In people,** the mechanism is not established
3 small human studies, mostly from Russia
Mouse, rat, monkey and cell studies

practical.routes: Under-the-tongue spray; injection beside the eye
practical.monitored: Melatonin breakdown product in urine, clock genes

regulatory.text: Compounding allowed, acetate, SC or IM (Oct 2026)
Not named; S0 bans unapproved substances

references: FDA, Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee briefing on epitalon, July 2026
